# AI Act classification: scout-large 0.1.2

Not legal advice. Classification by the provider under Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, references checked 2026-10-08 (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 as amended by the digital omnibus (in force 2026-07-27)).

- **AI system (Art. 3(1)):** yes. Weights are published together with inference code (SpanExtractor), so the model is usable as a machine-based system that infers outputs from input text (Art. 3(1)).
- **General-purpose AI model (Art. 3(63)):** no. A token-classification encoder for one task (extracting jobs, pains and gains); it does not generate content and is not capable of a wide range of distinct tasks; compute far below the indicative 10^23 FLOP of the Commission GPAI guidelines (July 2025). Parameters: 560,000,000. Estimated training compute: 2.7e+16 FLOP (fine-tuning; method: Fine-tuning: 6 x 5.6e8 parameters x 1.0e6 training tokens x 8 epochs. Base model: 6 x 5.6e8 x 6.3e12 tokens from the XLM-R training setup (Conneau et al. 2020: 1.5M updates, batch 8192, sequence length 512). Own estimates, not provider figures.); base model: 2.1e+22 FLOP. Indicative threshold of the Commission guidelines: 10^23 FLOP and generative capability.
- **Open-source exclusion:** art2_12; monetisation: none.
- **Intended purpose:** Product discovery in mobility: finding what people try to get done (jobs), what gets in their way (pains) and what they would gain, in interviews, forum posts, reviews, studies and other texts. Every item comes with the sentence or clause it was found in, so a person can check it. The output is input for later steps (deduplication, clustering, prioritization), which this model does not do.
- **Out of scope:**
  - Decisions about individuals; profiling or identifying the authors of texts; texts outside mobility (it was trained on mobility texts only); treating the output as a complete or final list of needs without human review.
- **High-risk (Annex III):** none (no use in employment, education, credit, essential services, law enforcement, migration, justice or biometrics is intended). **Annex I / safety component:** none; safety component: no. Text analysis for product discovery; not a component of a product covered by Annex I.
- **Transparency obligations (Art. 50):** none (no interaction with natural persons, no generated content).
- **Export control:** not listed (Regulation (EU) 2021/821, Annex I). A text classifier for product discovery; no cryptography, no intrusion software, no listed item.
